# 7 Best Pickaxe Alternatives in 2026

AI Agent BuilderNo-Code AI

Pickaxe (pickaxe.co) is a no-code platform for building AI agents, bundling them into a branded “Studio,” and selling access to end users through Stripe. It is aimed at consultants, coaches, and creators who want to package AI expertise as a product.

Two things in the pricing model send people looking for something else. [...] Where it falls short: no published prices. The pricing page offers a free trial on the agency track and a demo booking for everything else, so you cannot budget without talking to sales.

Best for: consultants building agents for a handful of paying clients rather than selling a self-serve product.

Pricing: not published; free trial on the agency track

## 4. Chatbase

Worth naming separately because a large share of Pickaxe builds are really customer support bots, and this is a support-specific tool with a free tier.

What makes it different from Pickaxe: deep support tooling out of the box, including helpdesk, voice, telephony, and integrations with Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, and Freshdesk. You are buying a finished support product rather than assembling one. [...] What is the cheapest Pickaxe alternative? MindStudio at $20/month plus usage, and it is the only option here that lets you bring your own API keys and pay model providers at cost.

Which alternative can also sell agents to customers? Voiceflow’s agency track is the closest match, though it publishes no pricing. Most other platforms build the agent and leave billing to you.
